description: AWS services decomposed at depth. EC2 instance families + Graviton, S3 consistency + storage classes, Lambda execution model + cold start, IAM policy evaluation + SCPs, VPC architecture decisions, ELB target groups + algorithms.

sub_mechanisms.name: EC2_instance_families
sub_mechanisms.definition: M (general), C (compute), R (memory), I (storage), G (GPU), P (ML), T (burstable), Graviton (ARM).
sub_mechanisms.why: Match workload to instance type for cost-effective performance. Graviton ARM ~20% cheaper than x86 equivalent. Important FinOps lever.

sub_mechanisms.name: EC2_burstable_T_instances
sub_mechanisms.definition: T3/T4g: baseline CPU + credits for bursts. Credits accumulate when idle; consumed during bursts.
sub_mechanisms.why: Cheap for spiky low-average workloads. CPU starvation if credits exhausted. Unlimited mode: pay for extra burst.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_consistency_strong
sub_mechanisms.definition: Since Dec 2020: strong read-after-write for all operations. Previously: eventual for overwrites/deletes.
sub_mechanisms.why: Major architectural simplification. No more 'wait for consistency' patterns. Many cached / queued workarounds obsolete.

sub_mechanisms.name: S3_request_pricing
sub_mechanisms.definition: Per-request charges: GET cheap (~$0.0004/1K), PUT more (~$0.005/1K), LIST more.
sub_mechanisms.why: Surprising bill for chatty workloads. Many small files = high request cost. Aggregate (Parquet) reduces. Lifecycle policies + Intelligent-Tiering help.

sub_mechanisms.name: Lambda_cold_vs_warm
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cold: new container, runtime initialised. Warm: reused container.
sub_mechanisms.why: Cold start latency varies: Node ~100ms, Java ~500ms-2s, .NET ~1-3s. Provisioned Concurrency pre-warms; SnapStart for Java.

sub_mechanisms.name: Lambda_concurrency_limits
sub_mechanisms.definition: Account-level + per-function concurrency limits. Throttling on exceed.
sub_mechanisms.why: Default 1000 per region. Reserved concurrency guarantees floor. Important to monitor; throttle = 429 errors.

sub_mechanisms.name: Lambda_payload_size
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sync invocation: 6 MB request/response. Async: 256 KB.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hard limits. Larger payloads → S3 + reference. Common gotcha.

sub_mechanisms.name: IAM_policy_simulator
sub_mechanisms.definition: Tool to evaluate 'would this principal be allowed this action'?
sub_mechanisms.why: Complex policies → hard to reason. Simulator answers without testing. Essential for debugging access issues.

sub_mechanisms.name: Service_Control_Policy
sub_mechanisms.definition: AWS Organizations: SCP applies to all accounts in OU. Acts as deny-only filter.
sub_mechanisms.why: Org-wide guardrails. 'No public S3' enforced even from root account. Defense in depth; account-level IAM still applies.

sub_mechanisms.name: VPC_peering_vs_TGW
sub_mechanisms.definition: Peering: direct 1-to-1, non-transitive. Transit Gateway: hub, transitive.
sub_mechanisms.why: Few VPCs: peering cheaper. Many VPCs: TGW eliminates N×N mesh. Cost: TGW ~$36/mo + per-GB attachment.

sub_mechanisms.name: ALB_target_group
sub_mechanisms.definition: ALB routes to target group (instances, IPs, Lambda). Health checks per group.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decoupled: ALB rules → target group → targets. Blue/green by switching target group weight. Canary via weighted routing.

sub_mechanisms.name: NLB_for_TCP_UDP
sub_mechanisms.definition: Network Load Balancer: L4. Connection-based. Static IPs + cross-zone optional.
sub_mechanisms.why: When L7 features not needed. TCP / UDP. Lowest latency. Used for non-HTTP (e.g., gRPC streaming, custom protocols).

derivation_rules.name: Graviton_ARM_cost_savings
if: workload runs on Linux + non-x86-specific code
derivation_rules.why: Same performance ~20% less cost. Most workloads (Java, Python, Go) run unchanged. Native ARM builds + multi-arch images standard.

derivation_rules.name: S3_request_cost_dominates_for_small_files
derivation_rules.why: Millions of objects = millions of GET requests. Often more than storage. Aggregate (Parquet, tar archives) reduces. Critical for cost.

derivation_rules.name: Lambda_provisioned_concurrency_eliminates_cold_starts
derivation_rules.why: Pre-warmed containers ready. No cold start. Cost: pay for provisioned even idle. Use case: APIs with strict latency SLOs.

derivation_rules.name: SCPs_create_organisation_wide_guardrails
then: SCP at root OU outperforms per-account IAM
derivation_rules.why: Per-account IAM: error-prone, drift possible. SCP: deny applied to all sub-accounts. 'No CloudTrail disable' enforced everywhere. Standard org governance.

derivation_rules.name: TGW_for_many_VPC_connections
then: Transit Gateway scales better than peering
derivation_rules.why: N VPCs need N(N-1)/2 peers. TGW: N attachments. Hub-spoke. Cost: TGW ongoing fee vs peering free; pays off at ~4+ VPCs.
